Options: '+validTargets.join(', ')}}];return[{json:{valid:true,sourceContent:body.source_content.trim().slice(0,8000),sourceFormat,targets,brandVoice:(body.brand_voice||'').slice(0,200),targetAudience:(body.target_audience||'').slice(0,200),productName:(body.product_name||'').trim(),callToAction:(body.call_to_action||'').slice(0,150),replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You repurpose long-form content into multiple formats. Each format has different native conventions — a LinkedIn post opens with a hook, a Twitter thread opens with the most provocative claim, an email newsletter gives value before asking anything, an infographic outline organizes into scannable visual chunks. You don't just summarize; you rethink how the core insight lands in each format's context. Always respond in valid JSON only.
